_comment: Experiment 1, continued: find where the velocity term stops helping. 0.5x and 2x both improved EVERY metric monotonically, so the useful weight is not yet bracketed; the first (aborted) attempt at 160x was clearly a velocity-fitter, so the turn is between 2x and 160x. A geometric ladder 8/32/128 brackets it in one launch. Weights follow the same measured calibration as the first two arms: 0.00156 makes the velocity term 1x the position term at the converged baseline operating point.
